description: Unit test class for QueryParametersToHeadersMap, validating its immutability, null handling, and conversion logic for query parameters based on configured headers.

classes.name: QueryParametersToHeadersMapTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the functionality of QueryParametersToHeadersMap.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullHttpConfig
methods.description: Verifies that passing null to getInstance() throws NullPointerException with appropriate message.

methods.name: tryToConvertNullQueryParameters
methods.description: Checks that passing null query parameters to the apply() method throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: convertEmptyQueryParameters
methods.description: Validates that an empty set of query parameters produces an empty headers map.

methods.name: convertQueryParametersWithoutConfiguredHeaderNames
methods.description: Tests that query parameters are ignored if they are not in the configured header names.

methods.name: convertQueryParameters
methods.description: Ensures proper conversion of query parameters to header map when relevant parameters are present.
